units: 6 arbitrary horizontal units = 3 game cells; not meters
rangeStatus: proposed blockout ranges, not final dimensions

states.idle: parked; background lamps may stay steady
states.work: alternating forward and return strokes while real order progresses
states.cancelled: end work motion and return to park
states.complete: stop work cycle; optional short return to park, no production delay
states.cancel: stop work cycle; visual return must not change gameplay

limits: One shared schematic mesh; shell details and courtyard facade follow approved f2.png. Motion ranges checked for no carriage overlap or end stop collision.
